_comment: Provenance for the programs beside this file: what create_item("0180", <the prompt `run.ts prompts` printed>) returned. `language` is what the PLATFORM routed the request to, which is not always what was asked for — see c1-t9-tm5-shorttext.

c1-t9-tm5-shorttext.note: Asked for 0180, routed to 0175. The prompt is a passage plus a written-response question with a rubric — the shape L0175 authors — so the composer read it as content to compose rather than an item to deliver. The file beside this one is the L0175 program it returned, kept verbatim as the evidence.
